logp.method_description: General procedure for the determination of Log D7.40: The solution was protected from light throughout the experimental procedure. A 25 mL of the octanol stock solution of the target complex was prepared by dissolving known amount of the Ru complex into 25 mL of octanol. 1 mL of the Ru stock solution was diluted by 3 mL of fresh octanol, followed by 4 mL of pH 7.4 phosphate buffer (aq.). The final solution was left to stir for 24 hrs at room temperature in dark. The two phases were then separated and serial dilutions were prepared and analyzed via UV-Vis spectroscopy (700 nm-300 nm) to determine the concentration of the ruthenium complex in solution. Log D7.40 was calculated by the following equation: Log(D) = [Ru]octanol / [Ru]aqueous.
